ruleDefinitions.name: Potential Tampering With RDP Related Registry Keys Via Reg.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of "reg.exe" for enabling/disabling the RDP service on the host by tampering with the 'CurrentControlSet\Control\Terminal Server' values

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ add\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\Terminal\\ Server.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*REG\\_DWORD.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/f.*"))) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*Licensing\\ Core.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*EnableConcurrentSessions.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*WinStations\\\\RDP\\-Tcp.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*MaxInstanceCount.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*fEnableWinStation.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*TSUserEnabled.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*TSEnabled.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*TSAppCompat.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*IdleWinStationPoolCount.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*TSAdvertise.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*AllowTSConnections.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*fSingleSessionPerUser.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*fDenyTSConnections.*")))
